West Virginia.mascotOrigin: The Mountaineer is a student chosen each year who wears a tailor-made buckskin suit and coonskin cap and fires a musket when the team takes the field and after every score; the costumed figure first appeared at games in the mid-1930s. The Mountaineers nickname was adopted in 1905 from the state motto, Mountaineers are always free.
West Virginia.colorsOrigin: Upperclassmen chose old gold and blue in 1890, taking them from the West Virginia state seal. The university says gold and blue, not blue and gold, to set itself apart from rival Pittsburgh.
